name: B10-0433/2025 (PPE) – 10th anniversary of the detention of jailed Swedish publisher Gui Minhai in China
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 10th anniversary of the detention of jailed Swedish publisher Gui Minhai in China
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Gui Minhai, a Swedish publisher of Chinese origin who was taken from Thailand in 2015 and has been held in China since. It says his trial was politically motivated and unfair, that he has been denied family visits, a lawyer and medical care, and that Sweden has been refused access to him. The Parliament asks China to free him and treat him according to international rules.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its position and asks China to release Gui Minhai.
- It concerns Gui Minhai, his family, Sweden and China's treatment of publishers and writers.
- Parliament sends the text to EU institutions, member states and Chinese authorities; no action is binding.
